title: Quarterly Business Meeting
description: Mark you calendar for our quarterly gathering. We'll come together to celebrate what God is doing, review our progress, and look ahead at what's next for our church family. We plan to wrap everything up and have you out the door by 7:00PM. Your voice and presence matter, we hope to see you there!
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
